thread:
Priya Kapoor: Heads up — console alert fired for sse_heartbeat_missing on redwood-prod at 10:14 UTC, looks noisy and correlated with heavy resume/backoff.
ops-bot: [automated] Alert created: sse_heartbeat_missing > 10 occurrences in 5m (env=prod)
Alex Chen: seeing same in traces. client heartbeats briefly stop when kvcache warms and we trigger backpressure :grimacing:
Marc Lo: can we confirm if it's client-side suppression or proxy dropping? We had a keepalive tweak in last canary.
Kira Patel: that canary rolled at 09:58. it introduced the 'suppress-heartbeat-on-backoff' flag in proxy.
Priya Kapoor: @Alex -- can you paste the query you used for counts? want to reproduce the spike.
Alex Chen: sure

```
count_over_time(sse_heartbeat_missing{env="prod"}[5m])
```

Alex Chen: overlayed with resume-backoff count looks aligned.
Priya Kapoor: the problem: console alert rule is absolute count over 5m so short, expected backpressure spikes spam the alerting channel.
Marc Lo: options: make rule sustained window, use rate-of-change, or surface a suppression metric from proxy and require it to be low to trigger alert.
Kira Patel: proxy currently sets header `X-Heartbeat-Suppressed` but we don't export that to Prometheus. we could increment `sse_heartbeat_suppressed_total{tenant="..."}` in exporter.
Priya Kapoor: short-term mitigation: silence/ack for 30m? but that hides true failures.
Alex Chen: prefer not to mute entirely. If suppression fails we want a signal.
Marc Lo: compromise: change rule to require sustained >10 over 10m to escalate, keep short window as a warning only.
Kira Patel: I'll add the suppression metric in exporter (ETA ~2h) and tag it with rollout_id so alerts include deploy context.
Priya Kapoor: console change: Alerts -> sse_heartbeat_missing: change threshold from >10 in 5m to >10 sustained over 10m for page. Who picks this up?
Kira Patel: I'll open PR to emit `sse_heartbeat_suppressed_total` and add label `suppressed=true` when header present.
Marc Lo: once metric exists I'll update the alert rule (ETA ~1h after metric lands). also will add annotation to show linked rollout id.
Alex Chen: also request: add deploy metadata in alert payload (commit, canary id) so oncall doesn't have to dig.
Priya Kapoor: agreed. Action items list for clarity:
- Kira Patel: emit suppression metric + rollout label in exporter (ETA 2h)
- Marc Lo: update alert rule to sustained window + add annotation (ETA 1h after metric)
- Alex Chen: add deploy metadata into alert payload / dashboard (small console tweak)
ops-bot: Incident updated: owner=eng-platform-oncall, severity=warning
Priya Kapoor: I'll monitor the next 30m and report back.
Kira Patel: ping me once you see PR feedback, I'll add unit tests for exporter header parsing.
Alex Chen: note: if suppression metric misreports we could get false negatives. keep raw traces in the alert link.
Priya Kapoor: good point. include link to raw trace view in alert annotation.
Marc Lo: also add a dashboard panel that overlays `sse_heartbeat_missing`, `sse_heartbeat_suppressed_total`, and `resume_backoff_count` for quick triage.
Priya Kapoor: thanks team :thumbsup:
